author: blu
body: Proves multi-effect cards. A card that does more than one thing compiles to more than one ability, and the engine applies them in order. Warrior's Helix deals 2 damage to a creature and gains its caster 2 life -- one spell, two StaticAbilities. Sage of Plenty draws a card and gains 1 life as it enters -- one creature, two OnEnterBattlefield triggers. Both come from the shared clause splitter, so "and" inside a card's text becomes separate effects.
